Name: Medium-Sized Tables
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCrfQoK.png[/img]
Ever been annoyed there are no 2x3 tables in the vanilla game? So was I until I realized "Wait, I can make some myself".

This mod adds a grand total of 19 tables based on most vanilla tables to the game that you can rotate to your heart's content. They're available by regular means (which means the furniture catalogue for most decorating afficionados). For special tables, see the config section below!

That is surprisingly everything I have to say about the features. Have fun decorating! If you want to see some examples to get inspired by, head to the images section.

If you have some designs using these tables to share, please do! I'm always happy about more pics. If you enjoy the mod, please also consider endorsing it! It makes me happy and makes it easier for others to find it, too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8BxUdEv.png[/img]
This mod has two different config options that are best edited with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]:
[list]
[*][b]Recolor[/b], unsurprisingly, determines which color scheme the tables use. There are four options to choose from: Auto (default), vanilla, VPR and Earthy. Auto attempts to automatically determine the recolor you use and changes the tables accordingly. If you want to use a specific recolor, you can choose from vanilla, VPR and Earthy color schemes (made to fit the base game, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿, respectively) manually.
[*][b]Exclusive Special Tables [/b]can be set to true or false and is true by default. If it's enabled, medium-sized tables based on special vanilla tables (aka the ones obtained from the junimo, wizard and retro catalogues as well as the table exclusively sold at the Desert Festival) are exclusively obtaines via those means as well. Regardless of this config, the medium-sized desert table is always sold at the Desert Festival as well.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sgtIh0y.png[/img]﻿
Easy!
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you've got SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed. If you've ever modded this game before, it's [i]very[/i] likely you already have them.
[*]Head to the files section of this mod and download the zip file or just click one of the download buttons at the top of this page.
[*]Unzip the downloaded file.
[*]Move it into your mods folder.
[*]???
[*]Success.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fCufpbD.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z0XVWJf.png[/img]
